items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 29, 2015 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I mean I’m a big fan of Dean Martin.

ctx.x: Hat size. I’ve got to borrow that one too. That’s great. So I know you have to get on the road. Do you have a piece of advice for aspiring singers? What should they always have?

Lots of air. Breathe deep. Don’t interrupt yourself when you sing. [sings] She gets too hungry for dinner [exaggerated breath] at eight. Don’t do that. Listen to Frank [Sinatra]. Nobody breathes better than that you know. I mean I’m a big fan of Dean Martin.
